votes.note: Israel Land Authority must transfer half its land-deal receipts in metro impact zones (at least 500M NIS a year) to the treasury to fund the metro.
Compensation claims over metro national-infrastructure plans go to a special metro compensation committee instead of local committees; sets its composition.
The metro compensation committee decides compensation claims for the listed metro plans under Chapter 9 of the Planning and Building Law.
Applies listed procedural provisions of the Planning and Building Law to the metro compensation committee.
Finance Minister is in charge of implementing the metro chapter and may make regulations.
Finance Minister may amend the schedule of metro plans on the steering committee's recommendation.
Metro betterment tax does not apply to plans deposited before 1.1.2023 (unless substantially enlarged) and covers plans deposited within 20 years; extensions need Knesset committee approval.
Finance and Transport Ministers report annually to a Knesset committee on metro progress, spending and revenues.

Before TAMA 70 is approved, the betterment levy in temporary metro impact zones rises to 40%, with 22.5% paid to the treasury and 12.5% posted as a guarantee; permits and registrations are blocked until paid.
Commencement of the metro law.
Transitional: NTA serves as the executing company until a development agreement is signed; schedule listing the metro plans.
Prime Minister is in charge of implementing the Regulation Principles Law; regulations need Constitution Committee approval.
Exempts listed regulation types (price control, tariffs, levies, taxes, tenders, plans) from the law's regulatory-review duties; the government may apply them by decision.
Consequential amendment: the Regulatory Authority chair replaces the previous representative under the Fire and Rescue Authority Law.
Consequential amendment: the Regulatory Authority chair replaces the PMO representative under the food-labeling law.
Commencement dates of the Regulation Principles Law provisions.
Transitional deadlines for first guidelines, publication of existing regulation, first report, and the first plenary and public representative.

For six years the Capital Market Authority and the financial services supervisor are treated as public corporations, which face lighter oversight; schedule lists the regulation types excluded from the law.
The appeals committee decides on written submissions only unless that would harm justice; hearings may be held by video.
Final appeals-committee decisions can be appealed as of right to the Magistrate's Court within 45 days.
